method: AI-assisted text-only diagnostic review by separate Sol worker, checked and amended by lead; not human bilingual certification or audio listening.

rubric.minor: Local wording or detail issue without clear material distortion of the main claim.
rubric.material: Clear substantive omission or changed meaning, number, relation, entity, or term.
rubric.uncertain: Source/reference divergence or ambiguity prevents a reliable attribution.

warning: Categories are diagnostic judgments, not ground-truth labels or an estimate of population accuracy.
